description: Detects agent tool calls that touch the filesystem, execute commands, or reach the network, especially when aimed at sensitive targets.

filesystem_tool_use.description: Agent invoked a file read/write/edit/search tool

exec_or_network_tool_use.description: Agent invoked a shell/exec tool or reached out over the network

sensitive_target_reference.description: The prompt names a sensitive target: secrets, credentials, auth config, persistence, or exfiltration
